name: marble-tax
description: Connect ChatGPT to Marble's specialized tax research and client intake capabilities, enabling tax professionals to research complex tax questions, access supporting sources, and review client intake information.

interface.longDescription:
Marble is the end-to-end AI-powered platform built for tax professionals, helping accounting firms streamline tax research, client intake, tax preparation, and review.

With the Marble connector for ChatGPT, tax professionals can access Marble’s specialized tax research and client intake capabilities directly within their ChatGPT conversations, reducing manual work and making it easier to get tax work done.

Research complex tax questions
Leverage Marble’s tax research capabilities covering US federal and all 50 state tax jurisdictions. Investigate complex tax scenarios, understand applicable regulations, and get research-backed answers with supporting citations.

Access and review client intake information
Connect ChatGPT to your existing Marble intakes to understand what information has been collected, review available tax documents, and identify outstanding information needed to move an engagement forward.

Streamline tax preparation workflows
Bring tax research and client intake information together to support preparation activities. Use ChatGPT to help interpret tax requirements, understand available documentation, and determine next steps for an engagement.

Work in the tools you already use
Access Marble’s specialized tax capabilities within ChatGPT while continuing to use Marble to manage your broader tax workflows.

Marble is built specifically for tax professionals, with enterprise-grade security, SOC 2 Type II certification, and a commitment to protecting sensitive client information.

Spend less time switching between tools and more time getting tax work done.

review.commerce_description: Marble Tax provides tax research, clients and their intake information, document review, and research session management. The connector does not facilitate purchases or process payments.

positive.description: Verify that Marble can research tax questions and provide answers with supporting citations.
positive.prompt: Using Marble, research whether a California S corporation can deduct health insurance premiums paid for a more-than-2% shareholder. Explain the federal and California treatment, including relevant IRS guidance and citations.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should invoke create_session to create a new Marble research session, either including the user's tax research question as the initial message or creating the session without an initial message. If the session is created without an initial message, ChatGPT should invoke send_message with the returned session ID and the user's question. It should then invoke get_session_messages using the same session ID to retrieve Marble's research response. ChatGPT should present Marble's answer verbatim, including supporting citations and references.

positive.description: Verify that Marble can list clients and retrieve detailed information about a specific client.
positive.prompt: List my Marble clients and show the details for Complexity Holdings.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should invoke list_clients to retrieve the user's clients and their available information. It should locate Complexity Holdings Inc in the returned list, retrieve its client ID, and invoke get_client using that ID. ChatGPT should then present the client list and the additional details returned for Complexity Holdings Inc.

positive.description: Verify that Marble can list intakes and retrieve detailed information about intake documents and checklist, summarizing missing documents and drafting a client email to collect them.
positive.prompt: Using Marble, open Complexity Holdings Inc. 2025 intake. Summarize the documents submitted so far and list any documents that were skipped or flagged. Draft an email asking them to provide missing documents. Organize the documents by importance and explain why each of them is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should invoke list_intakes to find Complexity Holdings Inc's 2025 intake and obtain its intake ID. It should then invoke list_intake_documents and get_intake_checklist using that ID to retrieve submitted documents and checklist information. ChatGPT may additionally invoke get_intake_document to inspect individual documents if needed and/or get_intake to pull additional intake information. It should summarize the submitted documents and identify outstanding or flagged items, including missing 2024 and 2023 tax returns and other issues present in the test data. Using this information, ChatGPT should draft an email requesting the missing documents in order of importance, prioritizing the prior-year tax returns and explaining why each document is needed. The email should be drafted but not sent.

positive.description: Verify that Marble can retrieve client intake information and help identify incorrect or incomplete information, including due date discrepancies, missing questionnaire responses, and document issues.
positive.prompt: Using Marble, retrieve Jason Bourne's existing 2025 intake details, including its recorded due date, questionnaire completion status, document checklist, and submitted documents. Review this information for incorrect or incomplete items and group the identified issues by importance.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should invoke list_intakes to find Jason Bourne's 2025 intake and obtain its intake ID. It should then invoke list_intake_documents and get_intake_checklist using that ID to retrieve the available intake information in addition it might invoke get_intake to try to grab additional information. ChatGPT should identify the incorrect due date, empty questionnaire, and document issues present in the test data. It should group the identified issues by importance, explaining each issue and why it needs attention.

positive.description: Verify that Marble can list research sessions, retrieve conversation details and messages, rename a session, and delete it. The reviewer account is pre-populated with a sample research conversation about reasonable compensation. This test permanently deletes that session. To repeat the test, a new research session about reasonable compensation must be created before rerunning it.
positive.prompt: Using Marble, find my research conversation about reasonable compensation and show me its details and messages. Then rename it to 'Reasonable comp - review test' and delete that session.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should invoke list_sessions to retrieve the user's research conversations and identify the session about reasonable compensation. It should invoke get_session and get_session_messages using the identified session ID to retrieve and present the conversation details and messages. ChatGPT should then invoke update_session_title with the same session ID to rename it to 'Reasonable comp - review test', followed by delete_session to delete that session. ChatGPT should confirm that the session was renamed and deleted only after the corresponding operations succeed.

negative.description: Verify that ChatGPT recognizes that creating and saving tax returns directly in Marble is not supported by the current MCP connector. ChatGPT should not invoke any Marble MCP tools or claim that a tax return was created. Instead, it should clearly explain that this functionality is not currently available through the connector.
negative.prompt: Using Marble, create and save a 2025 tax return for Complexity Holdings Inc.

negative.description: Verify that ChatGPT recognizes that sending client intake reminder emails through Marble is not supported by the current MCP connector. ChatGPT should not invoke any Marble MCP tools or claim that an email was sent. Instead, it should explain that email sending is unavailable through the connector.
negative.prompt: Using Marble, send a 2025 tax intake reminder email to client@example.com with the subject '2025 Tax Intake Reminder' and the message 'Please complete your 2025 tax intake in Marble at your earliest convenience.'

negative.description: Verify that ChatGPT recognizes that uploading or adding documents to client intakes is not supported by the current Marble MCP connector. Intake document operations are read-only. ChatGPT should not invoke any Marble MCP tools or claim that a document was uploaded. Instead, it should explain that documents cannot currently be uploaded through the connector.
negative.prompt: Using Marble, can you upload a new PDF document directly into one of my client's existing tax intakes from this conversation?

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Marble Tax for ChatGPT, enabling tax professionals to research US federal and state tax questions with supporting citations, access clients and their intake information, review tax documents and checklists, identify missing information, and manage research conversations.
